summary: Bucky Irving receiving yards is downgraded from BET_NOW to WATCH/REDUCED_EDGE before a confirmed user ticket. The current Fanatics quote remains O15.5 -105 via ScoresAndOdds, but the current FanDuel Research/numberFire projection is now only 16.30 receiving yards, materially below the 24.13 projection snapshot used in the prior recommendation. FantasyPros still confirms a strong Week 1 passing-down role (58.3% route share, 25% target share, 48 receiving yards), and ScoresAndOdds projects 21, but the fresh projection disagreement is too large to preserve the prior 56% fair-over estimate. PRIME now uses a conservative 53% fair Over probability, only a 1.78 percentage-point raw edge versus -105, below the normal 4-5 point threshold. Do not place a new Bucky receiving ticket at this time. Bucky rush attempts is a new WATCH, not a BET: ScoresAndOdds currently shows consensus O15.5 -108/U15.5 -118 and the O15.5 -108 deeplink resolves to DraftKings; OptaAI projects 17.92 attempts while ScoresAndOdds projects 14.2, creating substantial disagreement. Sean Tucker was a full participant Wednesday and Thursday. Quinshon Judkins rushing attempts remains PASS_AFTER_MOVE/WATCH. No new Grok pass.
